caption: Kitchen science with red cabbage water. #KitchenScience

beats.shot: extreme close-up on a jug of purple cabbage water
beats.does: pours purple red-cabbage water into two clear glasses
squeezes lemon juice into the left glass; it turns bright pink
beats.says: Add lemon juice and it turns pink.

beats.does: stirs a spoon of baking soda into the right glass; it turns blue-green
beats.says: Add baking soda and it turns green.

beats.shot: close-up on both glasses side by side
beats.does: lifts the pink glass and the green glass together
beats.says: Acids go pink, bases go green.

beats.does: smiles at the camera, holding both glasses
beats.says: Try it with anything in your fridge.
